title: Shure’s popular podcasting and streaming mic is almost $50 off
summary: While the Shure Mv7 Plus is popular with streamers and podcasters, it’s equally good at impressing your friends and coworkers on meetings and Discord calls. It’s currently marked down to $255 at various retailers, including Amazon, Guitar Center, and directly from Shure. That’s almost $50 lower than its usual price, and just a few dollars […]
llm_summary: The Shure MV7 Plus, a favorite among podcasters and streamers, is now on sale for $255—about $50 off its regular price—at major retailers like Amazon, Guitar Center, and Shure’s own site. While it’s built for high‑quality voice recording, the mic also shines in everyday video calls, meetings and Discord chats, making it a solid upgrade for anyone looking to improve their on‑air sound
